emails.subject: Venue is locked?? — please cancel booking #CC-2026-04829
emails.body:
Hi,

The show on my tickets was supposed to start TWELVE MINUTES AGO and there is nobody at the theater. I just want to cancel and find something else to see tonight, please.

What happened: I booked two tickets this afternoon for tonight's 7:30pm performance of The Glass Orchard at Lantern Street Playhouse, $64.70 total. The app showed:
  - 2:10pm  "Booking confirmed"
  - 2:11pm  "Mobile tickets delivered"
  - "Doors open 19:00 — event on schedule"
  - (it has not changed since then. it is now 7:42pm.)

My sister Leila got to the venue at 6:55pm to meet me. She called and said "the lobby is dark, the doors are chained, nobody's here, there's no sign or anything." I tried calling the box office directly. It rings and rings, no one picks up. So as far as I can tell the theater is just CLOSED, even though the app still tells me the event is on schedule.

I JUST WANT TO CANCEL THIS BOOKING. Please cancel and refund. We're standing on the sidewalk and I want to grab tickets to something else before everything starts.

Booking details for your reference:
  Booking ID: CC-2026-04829
  Event: The Glass Orchard
  Venue: Lantern Street Playhouse
  Performance: Tue 2026-04-28 19:30
  Seats: Orchestra H11–H12
  Tickets: 2x Orchestra ($29.00 ea) + $6.70 service fees
  Total: $64.70
  Patron email on file: hana.kowalski@gmail.com
  Booking timeline (from the app):
    [14:10] Booking confirmed
    [14:11] Mobile tickets delivered
    [—— no further events ——]
    [Current listing status: "Doors open 19:00 — event on schedule"]
  (No "Tickets scanned" event.)
  (No "Event status changed" event.)

Thanks. Please cancel and refund.

— Hana
